critique: The delivered field-level contribution is the exact finite-menu reduction and design–estimator saddle, supplemented by explicit nonrepresentability witnesses and a joint-signature collision program. It does not reach flagship level because the exact saddle remains exponentially large in general, while the polynomial result computes the collision surrogate rather than the exact minimax frontier and can lose a factor of sqrt(R_n). The graph-local separation is confined to a deliberately dense split-graph family, leaving the structurally important bounded-degree and sparse-local cases unresolved. The TL;DR, project justification, and interpretation accurately distinguish these proved results from the remaining open compression and sparse-local questions; no stale matched, sharp, or exhaustive claim is apparent.
